title: Side by Side: かたわら, がてら, かたがた, つつ(も), つ…つ, ともなく, なり…なり
description: Doing one thing alongside another (main job, outing, formal visit), while / although, back and forth, without really meaning to, and 'A or B or something'.

points.title: 〜かたわら: alongside (one's main work)
points.summary: Dictionary form / Nの + かたわら = while doing A as one's main activity, also doing B (long-term).
points.body: - 会社に勤める**かたわら**、小説を書いている.
examples: {彼女|かのじょ}は{子育|こそだ}てのかたわら、{大学|だいがく}で{勉強|べんきょう}している。
While raising children, she also studies at university.

points.title: 〜がてら: while (going out), also
points.summary: Noun (散歩, 買い物) / ます-stem + がてら = on the occasion of going out for A, also do B.
points.body: - 散歩**がてら**、郵便局に寄った.
examples: {駅|えき}まで{送|おく}りがてら、{買|か}い{物|もの}をしてきた。
I dropped them at the station and did some shopping on the way.

points.title: 〜かたがた: combining (formal)
points.summary: Formal noun (お礼, ご報告, ご挨拶) + かたがた = with the purpose of A as well.
points.body: - お礼**かたがた**、ご挨拶に伺いました.
examples: ご{報告|ほうこく}かたがた、お{見舞|みま}いに{参|まい}りました。
I've come to see how you are, and also to report back.

points.title: 〜つつ / つつも: while / although
points.summary: ます-stem + つつ = while (formal ながら); つつも = although (knowing …).
points.body:
- 悪いと知り**つつも**、うそをついてしまった.
- 景色を楽しみ**つつ**、歩いた.
examples: {悪|わる}いと{知|し}りつつも、ついうそをついてしまった。
I knew it was wrong, but I ended up lying.

points.title: A つ B つ: back and forth
points.summary: Paired verbs: 抜きつ抜かれつ (overtaking each other), 持ちつ持たれつ (give and take), 行きつ戻りつ.
points.body: - 抜き**つ**抜かれ**つ**のレース.
examples: {世|よ}の{中|なか}は{持|も}ちつ{持|も}たれつだ。
Life is all about give and take.

points.title: 〜ともなく: without really meaning to
points.summary: Dictionary form + ともなく = doing A absent-mindedly. QW + からともなく = from somewhere or other.
points.body: - 見る**ともなく**テレビを見ていた.
examples: どこからともなく{音楽|おんがく}が{聞|き}こえてきた。

points.title: A なり B なり: A or B (or something)
points.summary: Suggests options: do A, do B — whatever, just do something.
points.body: - 先生**なり**先輩**なり**に聞きなさい.
examples: {電話|でんわ}するなりメールするなり、{連絡|れんらく}してください。
Call or email — just get in touch somehow.

questions.prompt: {彼|かれ}は{会社|かいしゃ}に{勤|つと}める（　）、{小説|しょうせつ}を{書|か}いている。
notes: がてら is for an outing (散歩がてら), not a main job.
かたがた is for formal visits (お礼かたがた).
ついで needs に and is a one-off ('while I'm at it').
questions.translation: He writes novels alongside his office job.

questions.prompt: What does 「{彼女|かのじょ}は{子育|こそだ}てのかたわら、{大学|だいがく}で{勉強|べんきょう}している。」 mean?
options: She stopped raising children to study.
While raising children, she also studies at university.
She studies at university next to the nursery.
notes: かたわら here isn't 'beside (a place)'.

questions.prompt: {散歩|さんぽ}（　）、{郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}に{寄|よ}った。
notes: かたわら is for a long-term main activity.
かたがた is for formal purposes (お礼, ご挨拶).
散歩ついで needs に.
questions.translation: I dropped by the post office while out for a walk.

questions.prompt: {駅|えき}まで{客|きゃく}を{送|おく}り（　）、{買|か}い{物|もの}をしてきた。
notes: 送りかたわら isn't natural — かたわら is for ongoing work.
questions.translation: I took our guest to the station and did some shopping on the way.

questions.prompt: お{礼|れい}（　）、ご{挨拶|あいさつ}に{伺|うかが}いました。
notes: お礼ながら isn't a phrase.
かたわら is for ongoing work.
questions.translation: I've come to thank you and to pay my respects.

questions.prompt: What does 「ご{報告|ほうこく}かたがた、お{見舞|みま}いに{参|まい}りました。」 mean?
options: I reported on the way to the hospital.
I've come to see how you are, and also to report back.
questions.explanation: かたがた = **also with the purpose of**.

questions.prompt: {悪|わる}いと{知|し}り（　）、ついうそをついてしまった。
notes: ながらに is for set phrases (生まれながらに).
questions.translation: I knew it was wrong, but I ended up lying.

questions.prompt: {美|うつく}しい{景色|けしき}を{楽|たの}しみ（　）、ゆっくり{歩|ある}いた。
notes: かたわら is for ongoing work.
楽しみがてら isn't natural.
questions.translation: I walked slowly, enjoying the beautiful scenery.

questions.prompt: {二台|にだい}の{車|くるま}は{抜|ぬ}きつ{抜|ぬ}かれ（　）のレースを{続|つづ}けた。
notes: 抜かれて breaks the pair.
questions.translation: The two cars kept overtaking each other.

questions.prompt: What does 「{世|よ}の{中|なか}は{持|も}ちつ{持|も}たれつだ。」 mean?
options: The world holds on to people.
Life is all about give and take.
Everything in the world can be carried.
notes: 持ちつ持たれつ = mutual help.

questions.prompt: {見|み}る（　）テレビを{見|み}ていたら、{懐|なつ}かしい{顔|かお}が{映|うつ}った。
questions.explanation: Without really meaning to: **ともなく**.
notes: 見ることなく見ていた is a contradiction.
questions.translation: I was half-watching TV when a familiar face appeared.

questions.prompt: What does 「どこからともなく{音楽|おんがく}が{聞|き}こえてきた。」 mean?
options: Music came from nowhere at all.
Where did the music come from?
questions.explanation: QW からともなく = **from somewhere**.

questions.prompt: わからないことがあったら、{先生|せんせい}（　）{先輩|せんぱい}なりに{聞|き}きなさい。
notes: つ pairs two verbs (抜きつ抜かれつ), not nouns.
だの pairs with だの.
やら pairs with やら.
questions.translation: If there's anything you don't understand, ask a teacher or an older student.

questions.prompt: What does 「{電話|でんわ}するなりメールするなり、{連絡|れんらく}してください。」 mean?
options: Call or email — just get in touch somehow.
Call as soon as you've emailed.
Call and email at the same time.
questions.explanation: なり…なり = **A or B, whichever**.
notes: This なり isn't 'as soon as'.
